root.label: Parades Commission rules against Drumcree march in 1998

events.label: Parades Commission rules against Drumcree march in 1998

slots.name: decision upheld duration
slots.sentence: In 1998, the newly-established Parades Commission ruled that the Orange Order should not march down the road - a decision that was upheld for the past 28 years.

slots.name: ban year
slots.sentence: Annual attempts by the Orange Order to march through the area had triggered unrest across the region until the route was banned nearly three decades ago, in the same year that the Good Friday Agreement largely ended three decades of violence in Northern Ireland known as the "Troubles."
